svg.title: How Floodwatch makes the River Taw’s catchment outline: the operational catchment, intersected with the Taw’s water bodies and a box round the estuary, shown among its neighbours

text.tspan: Taw and North Devon Streams: all the land draining
to the Taw, and the Exmoor coast too

svg.text: 2. The Taw’s water bodies, and the estuary

text.tspan: Hydrometric area 50, which leaves out the
estuary’s banks, plus a box round the estuary
Gauges and overflows belong when inside it, or
close by and nearer to it than to any neighbour
